name: aqua-fall
action: Change ONLY the pose: he is truly FALLING down through the air, torso tilted 25 degrees toward the right, both knees bent with soles partly visible, both hands reaching DOWN toward someone catching him below on the RIGHT. Mouth open surprised. No walking, no waving, no gigantic foreshortened hands. Entire body normal proportions. No ground shadow.

name: aqua-walk-b
action: Next opposite-foot CONTACT frame in a LEFTWARD walking cycle. Preserve precisely same head position, hat size, camera, body height and looking back to the right smiling. Keep the raised waving arm at exactly same location. Swap stride: the previously trailing leg now forward pointing LEFT and the other leg behind. Both shoes visible and fullbody. No door, no ground shadow.

name: aqua-pass
action: PASSING frame between leftward walking stride contacts: support leg straight below hips, other knee bends forward toward LEFT with lifted shoe beside calf. Body remains upright looking back right smiling, raised hand at same position. Same face, hat height, body proportions and camera; fullbody all shoes visible. No door, no ground shadow.

name: purple-walk-b
action: Opposite-foot CONTACT frame in a RIGHTWARD walking cycle. Keep torso/head, camera, body height, facial expression, clothing and shoes EXACTLY unchanged. Swap leg stride and gently swap arm swing: previously trailing leg is now forward RIGHT and previously forward leg trails LEFT. Full body both feet, same character size. No door, no ground shadow.

name: purple-pass
action: PASSING frame between rightward walking contact strides. Support leg straight below hips, other knee bends forward RIGHT with raised sneaker beside calf. Upright body, arms passing hips naturally. Preserve exact face, camera, head size, clothing, proportions and full body height. No door or shadow.

name: aqua-pass-b
action: Leftward walking alternate passing pose: RIGHT leg supports body vertically under hips; LEFT knee lifts toward LEFT, left sneaker beside support calf. Keep raised waving arm and looking back RIGHT. This is opposite of a left support-leg passing pose.

name: purple-pass-b
action: Rightward walking alternate passing pose: RIGHT leg supports body vertically under hips; LEFT knee lifts toward RIGHT, left sneaker beside support calf. Natural arms passing hips. Same upright torso and smiling face.

name: red-walk-b
action: LEFTWARD walking opposite-foot contact frame: right leg now extends forward toward LEFT, left leg trails RIGHT, opposite of reference stride. Both hands keep holding backpack shoulder straps at precisely the same position. Keep head and torso fixed, smiling looking slightly upwardLEFT.

name: red-pass
action: LEFTWARD walking passing frame: left foot supports body vertically under hips, right knee bends forwardLEFT, lifted right sneaker beside calf. Both hands continue holding backpack straps exactly as reference, torso/head upright unchanged.
